title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.72: Enemy cleanups no longer break after Swap/Invert. Spiny Toad and Toadpole no longer go to negative Thorns when you Swap their Thorns away (they stay at 0). The Lost, The Forgotten and Hunter Killer no longer refund Strength/Dexterity you already Inverted into a buff (and Hunter Killer only refunds what it actually took, so My Own Lesson / Pulled Punch no longer over-refund).
